title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Ah, files all sorted. Relax. Not everything spills its secrets, and not everything merits recording. A document left to a Maylander detective? Well, that must be one not worthy of doctoring.

title: Talk 1
original: Now that Rhodes Island and Maylander have reached an understanding on our partnership, we'll be sending specialists for the follow-up. In fact, I'm more curious about my old friends on this ship. For example, the K'uk'ulkan, the Friston-3 robot, and you, Doctor.

title: Talk 2
original: Can I smoke in the office? If it bothers you, I won't exhale... Mmmm. Picked up this little habit during my time at a volcanic caldera in Bolívar. Can't seem to break it. But no worries, not like I have lungs to file a complaint.

title: Talk 3
original: Are those kids still following me? Fine. Let them believe the Columbian fairy tale is real... My exoskeleton sure grabs attention, and man, does it need regular maintenance. But I'm just too lazy to keep replacing it. Well, that's the force of habit... even a tin can gets used to its dents.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: Wanna take a look together? These are social dynamics reports from some academic journals. Helps us catch a glimpse of the new inventions and trends coming next year... Hmm? Of course it's necessary. Can you tell that I'm a revenant who's lived for millennia? See? That's the charm of keeping a youthful mind.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: W brought a swath of drastic reforms. Nasti's aiming for a city floating above the clouds... Hehe, you gotta admit, the Sarkaz vision for the future never disappoints. Me? I'm just an average joe working for the Foundation, investing in the next generation is where it's at.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: I like the top deck of Rhodes Island. It's got a great view. Too bad I didn't have a ship like this, or friends like yours when I was... scavenging, all those years ago... But I did meet Maylander Selene, and we roamed that wilderness together.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: Keep your distance and don't get yourself burned. Without witchcraft, sometimes this tin can sizzles in mere sunlight... Do I regret it? Perhaps. If becoming a pile of firewood could solve the Sarkaz's problems, then I'd hop right into the Soul Furnace. Yet, that's not how it works.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: Dame Kal'tsit and I talked a little about you. Don't worry. Your past won't be an issue for Maylander. Time sure flies for people like us, don't you agree? Care for a smoke? A few puffs and we'll be enjoying the sunset.

title: Idle
original: Good, I'll get the newspapers, and make us hot dogs with some nachos. Hats off to fast food, for keeping us pioneering without even a moment's rest. Great invention, don't you think?

title: Onboard
original: I haven't seen you since Trimounts, Doctor. Tin Man, P.I., representing the Maylander Foundation. Starting today, we'll be cooperating with Rhodes Island in a variety of sectors, along with sharing our resources... and secrets.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: It looks like Rhodes Island excels in its other business areas, besides just Oripathy treatment. We've got more room for cooperation... than I expected.

title: Promotion 1
original: And the last time I experienced something like this was by a campfire. Maylander Selene threw a map and a bottle of hard stuff across the flame, and invited me to join his team. Columbia wasn't even on the map yet... Hmph, it's like yesterday once more.

title: Promotion 2
original: Thanks. It's tough for people like you and me to trust, I know.

title: Added to Squad
original: Some people on this team are as talented and impressive as Maylander's agents. I'm interested to see how this operation unfolds, Doctor.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: Call me Tin Man, ladies and gentlemen. For this operation, I'm expecting you to follow all my orders to the letter.

title: Depart
original: I'll be finding a backup route for our operation.

title: Begin Operation
original: How about you take another way, good sir?

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: Let me stretch a little first. My joints are getting rusty.

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: Patience, my friend. Let me have a smoke first.

title: Deployment 1
original: Watch out for voice; it's the best vessel for curses.

title: Deployment 2
original: Even an old haunt has its perils.

title: In Battle 1
original: Don't treat history with such a flippant attitude.

title: In Battle 2
original: Don't imagine the future with such a narrow view.

title: In Battle 3
original: Found your archive... Alright, destroyed.

title: In Battle 4
original: Feel how your soul's imprisoned; it will be a lesson you won't forget.

title: 4-star Result
original: A few years ago, I heard some rumors about the Kazdel civil war. Seems time has not rusted your talents in this area, Doctor.

title: 3-star Result
original: I had a taste of it back in Trimounts, but your strategic planning and judgment here were truly impressive... Would you mind if I reported to the Foundation? They would be glad to know there's an outstanding commander behind Rhodes Island.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: They may have escaped the battle, but they can't escape the war.

title: Operation Failure
original: It's not a problem. Per our agreement, the Maylander Foundation is responsible for damage control. Leave this to me.

title: Assigned to Facility
original: Pretty nice room. Maybe once I get used to it, I'll turn it into my new body... Hehe, Just kidding.

title: Tap
original: What do you think happens when a human touches scorching hot metal?

title: Trust Tap
original: You... didn't spot me pulling smoke rings back in my body through the gaps, did you?

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Kazdel doesn't have New Year's celebrations like this, but in Columbia, I always join the kids in the square for the countdown to the bell. As a Rhodes Island operator, I guess I'll have to satisfy the children's curiosity about this tin man…

title: Greeting
original: You had a light, Doctor?

title: Birthday
original: Me? How to decide a revenant's birthday? Umm... The day I was born? Too long ago to remember. The day I got a new body? Then I'd have too many birthdays to count. Birthdays don't mean much to me. But for you, commemorating something is a way to validate your own existence, isn't it? Happy birthday, Doctor. How about we go for a walk?

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: Columbia, Kazdel of the future, and even Rhodes Island share one thing in common—Youth. Youth represents everything. Doctor, you and I are from the past, but at the moment, we're defending the future. I believe Rhodes Island and Maylander's partnership will continue.
